# Joel Martinez — push to main

> Go-to-market engineer in Seattle. I build the systems that run go-to-market: signal engines, propensity models, campaign infrastructure, and the governance rails that keep it producing without headcount. This file is the agent-friendly index — every case study below has a markdown twin (same content as the HTML, structured for extraction).

The work is organized as three rings:
1. **The Signal** — propensity models and signal engines that find who's worth talking to, the moment they're worth it.
2. **The Send** — campaigns and channels that turn signal into real conversations.
3. **The Rails** — the governance and plumbing that keeps it all running without me.

If you're evaluating what these systems could patch in your own GTM stack: each page states the problem, what was built, the verified numbers, and the caveats. Client work is anonymized; every metric is machine-verified from run logs, not projected.

## The Circus — personal tools, live

- [Merlin](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/merlin.md): Signal engine on Cloudflare — SEC Form D discovery, AI propensity scoring, durable Workflows, D1, live dashboard
- [Lamplighter](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/lamplighter.md): Fingerprints any company's GTM stack live from the edge, with an AI "field read"
- [The Math of Sales](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/math-of-sales.md): Interactive outbound calculator — revenue goal worked backward to daily dials
- [Cassette](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/cassette.md): Local-first meeting recorder/transcriber (Tauri + Whisper), System 7 aesthetic — in progress
- [Punch GTM](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/punch-gtm.md): AI-powered outbound agency — messaging mined from clients' real call recordings

## The Workshop — production systems built for clients (anonymized)

- [Email From Zero](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/email-from-zero.md): Net-new cold-email channel for a phone-only company — 6.1% reply, real opportunities created
- [Integrator's Exit](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/integrators-exit.md): 1,336-company AI-scored universe for an M&A-arbitrage thesis — seven-dimension propensity model
- [Clinical Signal Platform](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/clinical-signal-platform.md): 8-stage healthcare data platform with governance/audit layer — 4,948 practices, zero exclusion misses
- [SEC Form D Pipeline](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/sec-form-d-pipeline.md): 14,749 newly-funded companies filtered from ~99K SEC filings in ~24 seconds
- [Signal-Index Engine](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/signal-index-engine.md): Multi-tenant propensity engine + crash-safe, resume-from-death enrichment pipeline
- [Reply → Slack Relay](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/reply-slack-relay.md): One multi-tenant Cloudflare Worker turning campaign replies into rich Slack alerts — ~2 min per-client onboarding
- [CRM Sync Automations](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/crm-sync.md): Idempotent, state-tracked cron sync of outbound activity into HubSpot — 2,214 leads, 10 campaigns, zero duplicates
- [GTM Skill Library](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/skill-library.md): Parameterized, documented skills bringing governance to recurring GTM operations — 80% verified enrichment hit rate
- [Data-Companion Factory](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/data-companion-factory.md): Self-serve per-client data projects — 4 instances, no engineer in the loop after setup
